'''2000 North American Continental Championship Yannick Lapointe GenCon winner LS deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]]. Posted as 'GenCon winner LS deck' (15 August 2000); the description says 'test to 1 deck but most of the time i skip it'. Lapointe won the 2000 North American Continental Championship (GenCon, 11–13 August 2000); the post gives no record.<ref name="dt-9501">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9501 GenCon winner LS deck], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 15 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9501/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9501/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018135834/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9501/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
